statements.title: SANTACO elects new national leadership for the 2026–2030 term
statements.summary: The South African National Taxi Council concluded its two-day National Elective Conference at the Birchwood Hotel and OR Tambo Conference Centre in Ekurhuleni, electing the organisation's leadership for the 2026–2030 term. Motlhabane Abnar Tsebe was re-elected President, with BB Zondi as First Deputy President and Joe Sibanyoni as Second Deputy President.

statements.title: SANTACO mourns the passing of its first President, Thomas “Tom” Muofhe
statements.summary: SANTACO paid tribute to its founding President, Thomas “Tom” Muofhe, who played a pivotal role in uniting the taxi industry under a single national body following its formation in 2001.

statements.title: SANTACO denounces actions of Mpumalanga patroller
statements.summary: SANTACO condemned the conduct of an individual patroller in Mpumalanga, reaffirming that criminality and the obstruction of the free movement of South Africans are unacceptable.

statements.title: SMA Summit partner announcement
statements.summary: SANTACO announced its partnership around the Sustainable Mobility in Africa (SMA) Summit, underlining the industry's commitment to innovation, sustainability and the modernisation of public transport.

statements.title: A milestone in economic empowerment for the taxi industry
statements.summary: SANTACO marked a significant step in the economic empowerment of the taxi industry, advancing operator participation across the value chain.

statements.title: SANTACO Policy Conference statement
statements.summary: For the first time in the history of the industry, SANTACO convened a national Policy Conference bringing together delegations from all provinces and across modes.

statements.title: SANTACO National Office visits Limpopo on a strategic nationwide roadshow
statements.summary: As part of a strategic nationwide roadshow, the SANTACO National Office visited Limpopo to engage provincial structures and strengthen coordination.

statements.title: Taxi industry and Taxi Recapitalization SA launch first container retail spares shop
statements.summary: SANTACO and Taxi Recapitalization South Africa launched the first container-based retail spares shop, improving operators' access to affordable, genuine vehicle parts.

statements.title: SANTACO condemns violence amid Western Cape taxi industry impasse
statements.summary: SANTACO condemned the violence during the Western Cape taxi industry impasse, calling for calm, dialogue and the protection of commuters and operators.

statements.title: Mazibuko Motor Company revs up sustainability mobility in Africa
statements.summary: SANTACO highlighted the work of Mazibuko Motor Company in advancing sustainable mobility on the continent.
